notes: Cross-verse head consistency for phrasal verbs. nadach rendered led ... astray was headed on the particle astray, while the chapter's nine other verb-plus-adverb renderings all head on the verb. Rule 44 puts the head on the verb for a phrasal particle, naming away and forth as words that name nothing on their own; astray is that word class, and shavah rendered carried away at 21.17 is the same shape headed on carried. The light-verb class is untouched: zanah hiphil rendered made ... to play the harlot still heads on the lexical complement play. Only the target head of the nadach unit changes; every edge is otherwise as the verse pass returned it.
